chunks: And it is narrated from ʿĀʾidh al-Aḥmasī that he said:
I entered upon Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام while I intended to ask him about salat (prayer), but he began speaking to me before I asked him, and he said:
“If you meet Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, with the five obligatory prayers, He will not ask you about anything beyond that.”

key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer), the act of ritual worship being discussed
key_terms.اللَّهَ: Allah, before Whom the servant will be presented
key_terms.لَقِيتَ: you meet, meaning to come before Allah
key_terms.لَمْ يَسْأَلْكَ: He will not ask you, indicating sufficiency in this context

ai.seo_question: What is the status of the five obligatory prayers before Allah in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the immense importance of faithfully performing the five obligatory salat (prayers). It presents these prescribed prayers as a decisive act of worship with great weight before Allah عزّ وجلّ, highlighting their central place in a believer’s accountability.
